profile.description: Kimi K2.7 Code is Moonshot AI's coding-focused agentic model built on the Kimi K2.6 architecture, delivering substantial improvements on real-world long-horizon coding tasks and reducing thinking-token usage by approximately 30% compared to K2.6. It shares the same 1T parameter (32B activated) MoE architecture with MoonViT vision encoder, 256K context window, and native INT4 quantization. Thinking and preserve_thinking are always enabled for consistent reasoning across multi-turn agentic sessions. The model scores 62.0 on Kimi Code Bench V2, 81.1% on MCP Mark Verified, and 76.0% on MCP Atlas.
